svg.title: Position encoding order-sensitivity experiment
svg.desc: Executed NumPy comparison of reordered tokens. Plain self-attention has zero aligned differences, while sine-and-cosine position signals produce different attention weights and context vectors.

cc:Work.dc:title: Position encoding order-sensitivity experiment
cc:Work.dc:description: Executed NumPy results comparing two instructions with the same tokens in a different order. Plain self-attention has zero aligned differences, while sine/cosine position signals produce different attention weights and context vectors.
